картина: API-справочник generateContent/streamGenerateContent для Gemini на Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform; для разработчиков. ~80% строк — меню/дерево API. Разделы: вводная, Get started, Supported models (предупреждение: много картинок = выше задержка), Parameter list: Request body (JSON-схема), contents/parts (inlineData, fileData, thought, thoughtSignature, videoMetadata, mediaProcessing, mediaResolution), blob (MIME, 'no limit on image resolution', 7 МБ inline), FileData (GCS/HTTP ≤10 картинок/YouTube), safetySetting, generationConfig (temperature, topP, topK, candidateCount, maxOutputTokens, stopSequences, penalties, responseMimeType/Schema, seed, logprobs, thinkingConfig, mediaResolution), Response body (finishReason, в т.ч. IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT и NO_IMAGE; safetyRatings; usageMetadata), Examples (текст, мультимодальный вход, стриминг). Image-модели не названы ни разу; параметров вывода картинок (imageConfig/aspectRatio/imageSize/responseModalities) на странице нет. Промптов генерации картинок нет; кодовые блоки (11 <pre>) — схемы и примеры текстовой генерации/понимания картинки.
модели_на_странице: Gemini 3.6 Flash и новее (предупреждение о sampling)
структура: Examples (Text Generation, Using multimodal prompt, Streaming text response)

единицы.утверждение_en: Content is generated with Gemini through the generateContent or streamGenerateContent methods.
единицы.цитата:
Use generateContent or streamGenerateContent to generate content with
Gemini.
единицы.заметка: Общий метод; что им же генерируются картинки, страница не говорит.

единицы.утверждение_en: Adding a lot of images to a request increases response latency.
единицы.цитата: Note: Adding a lot of images to a request increases response latency.
единицы.заметка: Прямое предупреждение о цене большого числа входных картинок (референсов) — задержка.

единицы.утверждение_en: The request body lists generationConfig fields including thinkingConfig (thinkingBudget, thinkingLevel), mediaProcessing and mediaResolution; parts can carry text, inlineData, fileData, thought, thoughtSignature, videoMetadata, mediaProcessing and mediaResolution.
единицы.цитата: "thinkingConfig":{"thinkingBudget":integer,"thinkingLevel":enum},"mediaProcessing":string,"mediaResolution":MediaResolution}
единицы.заметка: Кодовый блок (html <pre> 0). В схеме НЕТ imageConfig, aspectRatio, imageSize, responseModalities.

единицы.утверждение_en: For single-turn queries contents holds a single instance; for multi-turn queries it is a repeated field containing the conversation history plus the latest request.
единицы.цитата: For single-turn queries, this is a single instance. For multi-turn queries, this is a repeated field that contains conversation history and the latest request.
единицы.заметка: Механизм мультихода: история передаётся заново в каждом запросе.

единицы.утверждение_en: systemInstruction holds instructions that steer the model toward better performance, for example 'Answer as concisely as possible'.
единицы.цитата: Instructions for the model to steer it toward better performance. For example, "Answer as concisely as possible" or "Don't use technical terms in your response".
единицы.заметка: Примеры инструкций текстовые.

единицы.утверждение_en: System instruction text counts toward the token limit.
единицы.цитата: The text strings count toward the token limit.

единицы.утверждение_en: The role field of systemInstruction is ignored and does not affect model performance.
единицы.цитата: The role field of systemInstruction is ignored and doesn't affect the performance of the model.

единицы.утверждение_en: Only text should be used in systemInstruction parts, and each part's content should be a separate paragraph.
единицы.цитата: Note: Only text should be used in parts and content in each part should be in a separate paragraph.
единицы.заметка: 'should' — рекомендация; картинки в system instruction не класть.

единицы.утверждение_en: safetySettings are per-request settings for blocking unsafe content, enforced on the response candidates.
единицы.цитата:
Per request settings for blocking unsafe content.
Enforced on GenerateContentResponse.candidates.

единицы.утверждение_en: The model role is used to insert the model's earlier messages into the conversation during multi-turn conversations.
единицы.цитата: The model value is used to insert messages from the model into the conversation during multi-turn conversations.

единицы.утверждение_en: A message is a list of ordered parts, and different parts may have different MIME types.
единицы.цитата:
A list of ordered parts that make up
a single message. Different parts may have different
IANA MIME types.
единицы.заметка: Порядок частей (текст и картинки) — упорядоченный список.

единицы.утверждение_en: Media can be supplied in a part either as inline raw bytes (inlineData) or as data stored in a file (fileData).
единицы.цитата:
inlineData
Optional: Blob
Inline data in raw bytes.
fileData
Optional: fileData
Data stored in a file.

единицы.утверждение_en: The thought field indicates whether a part represents the model's thought process or reasoning.
единицы.цитата: Indicates whether the part represents the model's thought process or reasoning.

единицы.утверждение_en: thoughtSignature is an opaque base64-encoded signature for a thought so it can be reused in subsequent requests.
единицы.цитата: An opaque signature for the thought so it can be reused in subsequent requests. A base64-encoded string.
единицы.заметка: Связь thinking и мультихода: подпись нужна для повторного использования мысли в следующих запросах.

единицы.утверждение_en: For video input, a clip can be selected with startOffset and endOffset and a frame rate set with fps; for example a 10-second clip starting at 1:00 at 10 fps uses startOffset 60 s, endOffset 70 s, fps 10.0.
единицы.цитата:
For video input, the start and end offset of the video in Duration
format, and the frame rate of the video . For example, to specify a 10
second clip starting at 1:00 with a frame rate of 10 frames per second,
set the following:
"startOffset": { "seconds": 60 }
"endOffset": { "seconds": 70 }
"fps": 10.0
единицы.заметка: Кодовый фрагмент с параметрами; промпта нет.

единицы.утверждение_en: videoMetadata should only be specified when the video data is provided in inlineData or fileData.
единицы.цитата:
The metadata should only be specified while the video data is presented
in inlineData or fileData.

единицы.утверждение_en: mediaProcessing (AGENTIC or STATIC) is only supported for Gemini models version 3.5 and higher; on unsupported models it falls back to STATIC fixed-rate frame extraction.
единицы.цитата:
Only supported for 3.5 and higher versioned Gemini models. If
set for a request using an unsupported model, falls back to
STATIC.
единицы.заметка: Image-модели на версиях 3/3.1 по нумерации ниже 3.5 (выведение, страница их не называет).

единицы.утверждение_en: Per-part mediaResolution controls how input media is processed and, if specified, overrides the mediaResolution setting in generationConfig.
единицы.цитата: Per-part media resolution for the input media. Controls how input media is processed. If specified, this overrides the mediaResolution setting in generationConfig.
единицы.заметка: Приоритет: уровень части > уровень запроса.

единицы.утверждение_en: mediaResolution LOW reduces tokens per image or video, possibly losing detail but allowing longer videos in context; supported values are HIGH, MEDIUM and LOW.
единицы.цитата:
LOW reduces tokens per image/video, possibly losing detail
but allowing longer videos in context. Supported values: HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW.
единицы.заметка: Компромисс токены ↔ детали входной картинки.

единицы.утверждение_en: Accepted input MIME types include image/png, image/jpeg and image/webp (alongside PDF, audio, text and video types).
единицы.цитата:
image/png
image/jpeg
image/webp
единицы.заметка: В этом списке нет image/heic и image/heif.

единицы.утверждение_en: There is no limit on input image resolution.
единицы.цитата: There is no limit on image resolution.
единицы.заметка: Про входные изображения.

единицы.утверждение_en: Inline media is sent as base64-encoded data, and the media type (mimeType) must also be specified.
единицы.цитата:
The base64 encoding of the image, PDF, or video
to include inline in the prompt. When including media inline, you must also specify the media
type (mimeType) of the data.

единицы.утверждение_en: Inline image data is limited to 7 MB.
единицы.цитата: Size limit: 7 MB for images

единицы.утверждение_en: A Cloud Storage object given as fileUri must be publicly readable or reside in the same Google Cloud project that sends the request.
единицы.цитата:
Cloud Storage bucket URI: The object must either be publicly readable or reside in
the same Google Cloud project that's sending the request.

единицы.утверждение_en: Files given by HTTP URL must be publicly readable; a request can include one video file, one audio file and up to 10 image files, and audio, video and documents cannot exceed 15 MB.
единицы.цитата:
HTTP URL: The file URL must be publicly readable. You can specify one video file, one
audio file, and up to 10 image files per request. Audio files, video files, and documents can't
exceed 15 MB.
единицы.заметка: Потолок 10 картинок относится к HTTP-URL.

единицы.утверждение_en: A YouTube video must be owned by the signed-in account or be public, and only one YouTube URL is supported per request.
единицы.цитата:
YouTube video URL:The YouTube video must be either owned by the account that you used
to sign in to the Google Cloud console or be public. Only one YouTube video URL is supported per
request.

единицы.утверждение_en: When specifying fileURI the mimeType must also be specified, and media file URLs are not supported when VPC Service Controls is enabled.
единицы.цитата:
When specifying a fileURI, you must also specify the media type
(mimeType) of the file. If VPC Service Controls is enabled, specifying a media file
URL for fileURI is not supported.

единицы.утверждение_en: The video fps sent to the model defaults to 1.0, must be greater than 0.0 and can be at most 24.0.
единицы.цитата:
The frame rate of the video sent to the model. Defaults to
1.0 if not specified. The minimum accepted value is as low
as, but not including, 0.0. The maximum value is
24.0.

единицы.утверждение_en: Configurable safety categories are sexually explicit, hate speech, harassment and dangerous content.
единицы.цитата:
HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT
HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH
HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT
HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT

единицы.утверждение_en: Safety thresholds are OFF, BLOCK_NONE, BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE, BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE and BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH.
единицы.цитата:
OFF
BLOCK_NONE
BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE
BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE
BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH

единицы.утверждение_en: The safety method specifies whether the threshold uses the probability or the severity score; by default the probability score is used.
единицы.цитата: Specify if the threshold is used for probability or severity score. If not specified, the threshold is used for probability score.

единицы.утверждение_en: BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE blocks more, BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH blocks less, BLOCK_NONE blocks none, and OFF switches safety off only if all categories are turned OFF.
единицы.цитата:
BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE
Block low threshold and higher (i.e. block more).
BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE
Block medium threshold and higher.
BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH
Block only high threshold (i.e. block less).
BLOCK_NONE
Block none.
OFF
Switches off safety if all categories are turned OFF

единицы.утверждение_en: The SEVERITY block method uses both probability and severity scores, while PROBABILITY uses only the probability score.
единицы.цитата:
SEVERITY
The harm block method uses both probability and severity scores.
PROBABILITY
The harm block method uses the probability score.

единицы.утверждение_en: Temperature controls randomness in token selection: lower values suit less open-ended or creative responses, higher values can give more diverse or creative results.
единицы.цитата:
Temperature controls the degree of randomness in token selection.
Lower temperatures are good for prompts that require a less open-ended or creative response, while
higher temperatures can lead to more diverse or creative results.
единицы.заметка: Объяснение дано в терминах токенов/текста.

единицы.утверждение_en: A temperature of 0 always selects the highest-probability tokens, making responses mostly deterministic with a small amount of variation still possible.
единицы.цитата:
A temperature of 0
means that the highest probability tokens are always selected. In this case, responses for a given
prompt are mostly deterministic, but a small amount of variation is still possible.

единицы.утверждение_en: If a response is too generic, too short or a fallback, try increasing the temperature; if the model enters infinite generation, raising temperature to at least 0.1 may help.
единицы.цитата:
If the model returns a response that's too generic, too short, or the model gives a fallback
response, try increasing the temperature. If the model enters infinite generation, increasing the
temperature to at least 0.1 may lead to improved results.
единицы.заметка: 'try' / 'may' — рекомендация; сформулировано для текстовых ответов.

единицы.утверждение_en: 1.0 is the recommended starting value for temperature.
единицы.цитата:
1.0 is the
recommended starting value for temperature.

единицы.утверждение_en: For Gemini 3 models up to version 3.5 Flash, temperature ranges from 0.0 to 2.0 with a default of 1.0.
единицы.цитата: Range for Gemini 3 models versions 3.5 Flash and lower: 0.0 - 2.0 (default: 1.0)
единицы.заметка: Image-модели 3/3.1 попадают в этот диапазон версий по нумерации (выведение).

единицы.утверждение_en: For Gemini 3.6 Flash and later, custom temperature, topP and topK values are ignored and custom frequencyPenalty/presencePenalty values return an error, so these parameters should be removed.
единицы.цитата: Warning: For Gemini 3.6 Flash and later models, custom values for sampling parameters (temperature, topP, and topK) aren't supported and are ignored if set
единицы.заметка: Image-модели здесь не названы.

единицы.утверждение_en: topP (nucleus sampling) selects tokens from most to least probable until their probabilities sum to the topP value; lower values give less random responses; range 0.0-1.0.
единицы.цитата: Tokens are selected from the most (see top-K) to least probable until the sum of their probabilities equals the top-P value.
единицы.заметка: Диапазон: 'Range: 0.0 - 1.0'.

единицы.утверждение_en: topK makes the model consider only the k most probable next tokens, which can give more coherent and less random text.
единицы.цитата:
The model considers only the top k most probable tokens for
the next token.
единицы.заметка: Описано для текста.

единицы.утверждение_en: candidateCount sets the number of response variations; output tokens of all candidates are charged, input tokens only once.
единицы.цитата:
The number of response variations to return. For each request, you're charged for the
output tokens of all candidates, but are only charged once for the input tokens.

единицы.утверждение_en: Multiple candidates is a Preview feature that works with generateContent but not streamGenerateContent.
единицы.цитата:
Specifying multiple candidates is a Preview feature that works with generateContent
(streamGenerateContent is not supported).

единицы.утверждение_en: maxOutputTokens is the maximum number of tokens generated in the response; a token is about four characters and 100 tokens are roughly 60-80 words.
единицы.цитата:
Maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the response. A token is
approximately four characters. 100 tokens correspond to roughly 60-80 words.
единицы.заметка: Пересчёт в слова — для текста; про токены картинок здесь не сказано.

единицы.утверждение_en: A fixed seed makes the model try to return the same response for repeated requests, but determinism is not guaranteed and changing the model or parameters such as temperature can still vary the response; the default seed is random.
единицы.цитата:
When seed is fixed to a specific value, the model makes a best effort to provide
the same response for repeated requests. Deterministic output isn't guaranteed.
Also, changing the model or parameter settings, such as the temperature, can
cause variations in the response even when you use the same seed value. By
default, a random seed value is used.

единицы.утверждение_en: thinkingConfig configures the model's thinking process for Gemini 2.5 and higher models.
единицы.цитата: Configuration for the model's thinking process for Gemini 2.5 and higher models.

единицы.утверждение_en: By default thinkingBudget lets the model automatically control how much it thinks, up to a maximum of 8,192 tokens.
единицы.цитата: thinkingBudget: integer. By default, the model automatically controls how much it thinks up to a maximum of 8,192 tokens.

единицы.утверждение_en: thinkingLevel controls how much internal reasoning happens before the response; higher levels may improve quality on complex tasks but increase latency and cost; values are MINIMAL, LOW, MEDIUM and HIGH, with support varying by model.
единицы.цитата: thinkingLevel: enum. Controls the amount of internal reasoning the model performs before generating a response. Higher levels may improve quality on complex tasks but increase latency and cost. Supported values are MINIMAL, LOW, MEDIUM, and HIGH (support varies by model).
единицы.заметка: Какие уровни у image-моделей — не сказано.

единицы.утверждение_en: finishReason FINISH_REASON_MAX_TOKENS means the maximum number of tokens specified in the request was reached.
единицы.цитата: FINISH_REASON_MAX_TOKENS: The maximum number of tokens as specified in the request was reached.

единицы.утверждение_en: FINISH_REASON_SAFETY means generation stopped because the response was flagged for safety, and Candidate.content is empty if content filters block the output.
единицы.цитата: FINISH_REASON_SAFETY: Token generation was stopped because the response was flagged for safety reasons. Note that Candidate.content is empty if content filters block the output.
единицы.заметка: Пустой content — признак блокировки фильтром.

единицы.утверждение_en: FINISH_REASON_RECITATION stops generation for unauthorized citations and FINISH_REASON_BLOCKLIST for blocked terms in the response.
единицы.цитата:
FINISH_REASON_RECITATION: The token generation was stopped because the response was flagged for unauthorized citations.
FINISH_REASON_BLOCKLIST: Token generation was stopped because the response includes blocked terms.

единицы.утверждение_en: FINISH_REASON_PROHIBITED_CONTENT means the response was flagged for prohibited content such as CSAM.
единицы.цитата: FINISH_REASON_PROHIBITED_CONTENT: Token generation was stopped because the response was flagged for prohibited content, such as child sexual abuse material (CSAM).

единицы.утверждение_en: FINISH_REASON_IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT means generation stopped because the image provided in the prompt was flagged for prohibited content.
единицы.цитата: FINISH_REASON_IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT: Token generation was stopped because the image provided in the prompt was flagged for prohibited content.
единицы.заметка: Блокировка по ВХОДНОЙ картинке (референсу), не по результату.

единицы.утверждение_en: FINISH_REASON_NO_IMAGE means generation stopped because an image was expected in the prompt but none was provided.
единицы.цитата: FINISH_REASON_NO_IMAGE: Token generation was stopped because an image was expected in the prompt, but none was provided.
единицы.заметка: Про отсутствие ожидаемой входной картинки.

единицы.утверждение_en: FINISH_REASON_SPII means the response was flagged for sensitive personally identifiable information.
единицы.цитата: FINISH_REASON_SPII: Token generation was stopped because the response was flagged for sensitive personally identifiable information (SPII).

единицы.утверждение_en: Response safety ratings report a probability level (NEGLIGIBLE, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH) and a blocked flag indicating whether the model's input or output was blocked.

единицы.цитата:
Note: For billing purposes, tokens consumed by document inputs to
Gemini 3 and later models are counted as image tokens.

единицы.утверждение_en: In the Python Gen AI SDK an image is passed together with a text prompt in the contents list via Part.from_uri with a gs:// file_uri and a mime_type.
единицы.цитата: contents=["What is shown in this image?",Part.from_uri(file_uri="gs://cloud-samples-data/generative-ai/image/scones.jpg",mime_type="image/jpeg",),],)
единицы.заметка: Кодовый блок (html <pre> 5); задача примера — понимание картинки, не генерация; порядок: текст, затем картинка.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: This reference documents no image-output configuration: the request body has no imageConfig, aspectRatio, imageSize or responseModalities, and the response body lists only text parts, so it cannot serve as the source for image-output parameters.
длинная_дистанция.как_получено: выведено из E-125-3, схемы Response body (строка 2893) и поиска по html (imageConfig/aspectRatio/imageSize/responseModalities — 0 вхождений)

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Input images can reach the model three ways on this page: inline base64 with mimeType (up to 7 MB), a Cloud Storage URI (public or same project), or a public HTTP URL (up to 10 images per request); media URLs are unavailable under VPC Service Controls.

The page names two input-side costs of adding images: many images raise response latency, and media resolution sets tokens per image (LOW saves tokens but may lose detail; per-part settings override the request-level one).

не_сказано: Нет imageConfig, aspectRatio, imageSize и responseModalities — ни в схеме запроса, ни в описании generationConfig.
В схеме ответа parts содержат только text — не описано, как возвращаются сгенерированные картинки (inlineData в ответе).
Не сказано, какие thinkingLevel поддерживают image-модели и можно ли отключить thinking у них.
Не сказано, сколько токенов стоит одна входная картинка при HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW mediaResolution.
Не сказано, как temperature/topP/seed влияют именно на генерацию изображений — все объяснения даны для текста.
сомнения: Страница общая для всех Gemini (сомнение из партии подтверждено): все единицы с моделями 'не указано' применимы к image-моделям только в той мере, в какой image-модели принимают эти поля.
topK в описании помечен 'Optional: float', в схеме — number; для счётного параметра это странно, но на правила о картинках не влияет.
Список MIME-типов (image/png, jpeg, webp) короче, чем может быть в карточках моделей (heic/heif здесь нет) — межстраничное сравнение не делалось.
Второй признак официальности — стандартный подвал Google и официальный SDK в примерах; строки 'Google LLC' нет.
